<p class="ao-start-here">This is the start. Meet the party, then walk the map. <a href="background.html">Background</a> explains the story names, what each area covers and how the course is laid out.</p>

::: {.ao-story}
Gaia's Rest stands at the root of the great tree, and tonight the bar is loud with boasters who swear they raised whole pipelines overnight and finished analyses before the ink dried, all by making a pact with an Astral, a spirit that speaks every tongue (here, a language model). In the far corner a few patrons sit silent over cold food and empty cups, and none of them will meet your eye. Four travellers take the long table, and Wanderer Quill, an old hand of the tavern, watches them from the hearth. When the boasters have gone to bed, ask Quill about the corner.
:::

## Meet the party

Four travellers share the long table. Choose the one closest to your own work: the choice is remembered, and it adds a little extra to some of the stories. The lessons are the same for everyone.

::: {.panel-tabset group="persona"}

## Guildmaster Aris

![](assets/img/persona-guildmaster.png){.ao-persona-img fig-alt="Pixel-art portrait of Guildmaster Aris: a figure in a green robe with a gold chain of office, holding a ledger and a glowing milestone beacon."}

**Research or project manager.** Guildmaster Aris keeps the ledgers, lights the milestone beacons and rations the budget. Their guild runs on deadlines, and a pact promises roadmaps and status reports without waiting on anyone. They have watched a flawless-looking demo turn out to be nothing of the kind, so they know the difference between "it ran" and "it is done".

*Where your discipline matters most:* the Gatehouse, the Scriptorium and the Cluster Citadel.

## Diviner Ilsa

![](assets/img/persona-diviner.png){.ao-persona-img fig-alt="Pixel-art portrait of Diviner Ilsa: a hooded figure in an indigo cloak holding a glowing glass lens."}

**Bioinformatics analyst.** Diviner Ilsa reads the signal in noisy data with trained hounds and a lens for ground truth: reference databases and controls. A pact offers literature summaries and analysis scripts in minutes. Diviner Ilsa knows how a fluent, flattering explanation can lead a tired mind to a conclusion that the primary sources never supported.

*Where your discipline matters most:* the Ancient DNA Crypt, the Sequence Maze and the Phylogenetic Forest.

## Artificer Bob

![](assets/img/persona-artificer.png){.ao-persona-img fig-alt="Pixel-art portrait of Artificer Bob: a figure in a leather apron with goggles on their brow, beside a brass gear."}

**Bioinformatics engineer.** Artificer Bob builds with Automata: scripts, pipelines and containers that do exactly what they were built to do. A pact could draft a workflow and its tests before the kettle boils. Artificer Bob has inherited a pile of code that nobody could explain, and will not add to it.

*Where your discipline matters most:* the Codon Mill, the Sequence Maze and the Pipeline Factory.

## Archivist Elowen

![](assets/img/persona-archivist.png){.ao-persona-img fig-alt="Pixel-art portrait of Archivist Elowen: a long-haired figure in spectacles with a ring of keys and a sealed scroll."}

**Data steward.** Archivist Elowen guards the vaults: raw data, checksums, ontologies and the metadata that makes a dataset findable. A pact can tidy a messy sample sheet in a moment. Archivist Elowen knows the danger of a tidy table whose missing values were quietly invented, and keeps a ledger of every change.

*Where your discipline matters most:* the Gatehouse, the Biodiversity Reef and the Scriptorium.

:::

Read [Background](background.qmd) for how the course is laid out and what each area covers. There is nothing to install yet: each lesson says when it needs a tool. Walk the map with the arrow keys (or WASD) and press Enter on a gate. The gold **▶ NEXT** marker is the suggested next stop. The map shows only the places on your path. More appear as you clear quests, or choose "Show the whole map" to see everything.
